mapper.insert: INSERT INTO work_order_logs ( work_order_id, event_type, from_status, to_status, title, detail, actor_user_id ) VALUES ( #{log.workOrderId}, #{log.eventType}, #{log.fromStatus}, #{log.toStatus}, #{log.title}, #{log.detail}, #{log.actorUserId} )
mapper.select: ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC

SELECT id, tenant_id AS tenantId, site_id AS siteId, order_no AS orderNo, title, equipment_id AS equipmentId, description, priority, status, assignee_user_id AS assigneeUserId, team_id AS teamId, version, due_at AS dueAt, completed_at AS completedAt, created_by AS createdBy, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM work_orders WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT e.id, e.tenant_id, e.site_id, e.asset_code, e.name, e.model, e.location, e.category, e.status, e.health, e.next_maintenance_at, e.runtime_hours, e.image_ref, e.installed_at, e.manager_user_id, e.created_at, e.updated_at FROM work_orders w INNER JOIN equipment e ON e.id = w.equipment_id AND e.tenant_id = w.tenant_id AND e.site_id = w.site_id WHERE w.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND w.id = #{workOrderId}

SELECT wp.id, wp.work_order_id, wp.spare_part_id, p.part_code, p.name AS part_name, p.spec, p.unit, wp.planned_quantity, wp.issued_quantity, wp.returned_quantity, wp.created_at, wp.updated_at FROM work_order_parts wp INNER JOIN work_orders w ON w.id = wp.work_order_id INNER JOIN spare_parts p ON p.id = wp.spare_part_id AND p.tenant_id = w.tenant_id WHERE w.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND wp.work_order_id = #{workOrderId} ORDER BY wp.id ASC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_order_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'PENDING' AND assignee_user_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pending_dispatch_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'PENDING' AND assignee_user_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pending_start_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'IN_PROGRESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS in_progress_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'AWAITING_ACCEPTANCE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS awaiting_acceptance_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS completed_count FROM work_orders WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}
